hypotheses.proposition: Existing G9 record/rule/EffectIntent semantics plus a typed host adapter are sufficient to lower and execute a bounded HTTP server without adding HTTP-specific core ClayCode syntax.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The adapter is hiding missing language semantics that will fail when errors, lifetimes, streaming, cancellation or cross-backend equivalence are required.
hypotheses.falsifier: A frozen APP-02 program requires an unrepresentable semantic distinction even when a typed FFI/resource adapter is available.

hypotheses.proposition: Network bind/serve authority can remain host-owned while guest code receives only an already-authorized opaque listener resource handle; generated program identity need not depend on capability-instance secrets.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A raw OS file descriptor is too weakly typed and becomes forgeable or ambient when the guest can access unrestricted host APIs.
hypotheses.falsifier: A sandboxed guest can acquire equivalent network authority without a host grant, or handle substitution crosses the declared resource/scope boundary.

hypotheses.proposition: A WebAssembly Component Model/WASI-style typed resource/import boundary is a strong candidate for a portable ClayCode HTTP FFI backend because capability availability can be determined by host-provided imports rather than source text.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Native Linux handle passing is simpler, faster and sufficiently portable for the initial BASE release, making WASI unnecessary or costly.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched Clay IR lowering shows WASI cannot preserve required HTTP/error/async/resource semantics or incurs unacceptable cost relative to native.

hypotheses.proposition: The next highest-information APP-02 test is differential lowering of one frozen canonical HTTP IR to two backends with identical semantic receipts and negative authority tests, rather than further language redesign.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Parser/type/effect surface closure is still too unstable for meaningful backend differential testing.
hypotheses.falsifier: Current parser/IR cannot freeze the test program reproducibly enough to feed two backend lowerers.
